querySql:
select 
                                      object_id,
                                      s_info_compcode,
                                      report_period,
                                      s_change_itemcode,
                                      s_change_reason,
                                      s_approval_program,
                                      be_affected_itemcode,
                                      influence_money,
                                      crncy_code,
                                      ann_date,
                                      be_affected_report_period,
                                      be_affected_report_type,
                                      be_affected_subject,
                                      processing_result,
                                      opdate,
                                      opmode,
                                      to_char(sysdate - 1, 'yyyymmdd') as bath_dt,
                                      cast(sysdate as timestamp) as data_ins_time,
                                      'w_ashareaccountingchange.json' as task_rs_id
                                from ${srcoradbname}.ashareaccountingchange WHERE report_period BETWEEN '${busi_month}'||'01' AND to_char(add_months(to_date('${busi_month}'||'01','yyyyMMdd'),1)-1,'yyyyMMdd')
